artifacts.summary: 15-phase plan for the L^▷ proof system: OpenAxiom (18 restricted-modal + 53 re-declared TM⁺ constructors), OpenDerivationTree, eraseOpen with a wildcard-free discharge table, the two validity dispatch lemmas assembled from five block helpers, soundness, conservativity over TM⁺ in both directions and over TM at four classes, the Determined collapse, and the ledger surfaces.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh assertion B asserts the library-wide UPWARD import set EQUALS a frozen ALLOWLIST (a frozenset beside _SRC in that script) and fails on a SURPLUS as well as a shortfall. Any NEW layer-0 file in a FormalSystem/<Lang>Language/ directory that imports a higher-layer module (typically FormalSystem.Theorems.*, layer 2) therefore breaks the gate unless the allowlist is extended in the SAME phase as the imports, with entries derived by running `python3 scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py upward-edges` rather than hand-copied. The tempting alternative -- giving the file a higher layer row in LANGUAGE_FILE_LAYERS to make the edge downward -- is explicitly rejected by that table's own docstring as a content judgement that reaches the same blind spot the allowlist exists to prevent. Precedent: FormalSystem/MinusLanguage/AxiomDischarge.lean is itself allowlisted for exactly this reason (8 lines, all into Theorems). Pair this with C26 in check-module-invariants.sh, which flags any live def/abbrev whose last name component carries a non-trailing underscore -- so Type-valued derivation-term defs must be lowerCamelCase (dischargePropK, not discharge_prop_k), while theorem names correctly stay snake_case.
